abstract: Embryonal cell carcinoma is a rare clinical entity. We report a case of a 20-year-old patient who presented with lump lower abdomen for last two months with primary amenorrhea and poorly developed secondary sexual characteristics. Ultrasonography (USG) whole abdomen showed lower abdominal mass approximately 15×15×10 cm, probably neoplastic changes in intra-abdominal testis, with mild ascites, no uterus and ovaries. Fine needle aspiration cytology from the tumor mass reported the possibility of non-seminomatous germ cell tumor, possibly embryonal carcinoma. The patient received three cycles of neo-adjuvant chemotherapy (Regime Bleomycin, Etoposide and Cisplatin) followed by laparotomy, at laparotomy (L) orchidectomy with removal of tumor, (R) orchidectomy, omentectomy and appendisectomy was performed. Postoperatively the patient received two more cycles of chemotherapy of the same regime. The patient has been under close follow-up for the last three years with no evidence of disease.
abstract_ja: 胎児性癌は稀な疾患である。20歳の患者が、原発性無月経と二次性徴の発育不良を伴う下腹部腫瘤を主訴に来院した。全腹部超音波検査(USG)で約15×15×10cmの下腹部腫瘤を認め、腹腔内精巣の腫瘍性変化が疑われた。子宮・卵巣は認めず、軽度の腹水を伴っていた。腫瘤からの穿刺吸引細胞診で、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍、特に胎児性癌の可能性が報告された。術前にブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン(BEP)療法を3コース施行した後、開腹手術を行った。手術では精巣摘除術、大網切除術、虫垂切除術を施行した。術後、同レジメンの化学療法をさらに2コース施行した。3年間のフォローアップで再発の所見は認めていない。
